findings: F-1 freeze.json is self-referential: entries deleted from files{} are accepted (a3: FREEZE_INTEGRITY OK files=9). Nothing outside freeze.json pins it; the later FROZEN diff treats FREEZE as baseline.

F-2 dirty-tree exclusion is an unanchored grep prefix match: untracked paths extending OUT's relative path escape detection (d3b: clean-tree-before.txt lists ?? .ufo/evidence/round-56/dryout-extra.txt, run proceeds to no-harm). The pattern is also unescaped regex.

F-3 gate 0b and the CONTROLS_* verdict greps read working-tree receipts while the blob checks target REV; both run before dirty-tree, so uncommitted receipt bytes participate in gate evidence (d1: gate ran on worktree copy; refused only later at dirty-tree).
F-4 second-invocation is per-OUT, not global: a second invocation with a different OUTDIR is not refused; the contract's deciding_invocations=1 is enforced by the wave, not the script.
F-5 [ -d "$OUT" ] accepts a non-empty OUT despite the usage comment saying EMPTY; only c1.start/c2.start are probed.
F-6 manifest 'amendments' is counted but never validated.
F-7 control-receipt-not-after-freeze is unreachable from a REV whose tree lacks the script (exit 127); faithful reachability requires a merge-shaped REV (demonstrated).
